summary.text: Todd Smola is a Republican state representative from the 1st Hampden District who has served since January 2005 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served as a Palmer selectman and worked as an education liaison for Palmer Public Schools.

paragraphs.text: Todd Smola earned an associate degree from Holyoke Community College and a bachelor's degree from Westfield State College, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as an education liaison for Palmer Public Schools, and he served as a Palmer selectman from 2000 to 2004.
Smola assumed office in the Massachusetts House on January 5, 2005.
For 2025-2026 he was ranking minority member of the House Ways and Means Committee, the House Committee on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability, and the Ways and Means Joint Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.
